source_title: Patreons Rivalry With Substack Is Growing Who Will Win Over Creators
snippet_primary: "Substack and Patreon are vying to become creators' primary revenue stream. For most influencers, payouts from platforms like Meta or Google aren't enough to build a sustainable career. Rather than spending their days hawking products, many creators are turning to direct fan support, and two companies dominate that space: Patreon and Substack. Patreon's latest move targets streamers. Its native livestreaming feature, currently in demo and set for a broad rollout this summer, could attract gamers and broadcasters alike. But Substack beat them to it, launching a similar live video tool just three months earlier."
subject_exact: third-party news article on Patreon and Substack competing for creator livestreaming features
